channel.title: SQP AI News Tracker
channel.description: Daily curated open-source LLM news for SQP developers

item.title: [new-model-release] Llama can now see and run on your device - welcome Llama 3.2
item.description: Llama 3.2 release with vision and on-device capabilities. Major model release with multimodal and mobile deployment support. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 9/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Llama 3.1 - 405B, 70B & 8B with multilinguality and long context
item.description: Llama 3.1 405B, 70B, and 8B models with multilinguality and long context. Major release of Meta's flagship LLM family. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 9/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Welcome Gemma 2 - Google’s new open LLM
item.description: Gemma 2 announced as Google's new open LLM. Major open-weight model release from Google. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 8/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Falcon 2: An 11B parameter pretrained language model and VLM, trained on over 5000B tokens and 11 languages
item.description: Falcon 2 is an 11B open-weight multilingual language and vision model trained on 5T tokens. Significant open model release suitable for deployment and fine-tuning. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 8/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] PaliGemma – Google's Cutting-Edge Open Vision Language Model
item.description: PaliGemma is Google's open-weight vision-language model available on Hugging Face. Significant open VLM release for multimodal applications. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 8/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Diffusers welcomes Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large
item.description: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large is now integrated in the Diffusers library. Provides access to improved image generation model for developers. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [tooling] Accelerate 1.0.0
item.description: Accelerate 1.0.0 stable release for distributed training. Major version milestone for core training acceleration library. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] Welcome Falcon Mamba: The first strong attention-free 7B model
item.description: Falcon Mamba 7B model released—first strong attention-free alternative to transformers. New architecture approach for efficient LLMs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [new-model-release] SmolLM - blazingly fast and remarkably powerful
item.description: SmolLM family of small language models combining efficiency and performance. Lightweight models for resource-constrained deployment. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [research] CyberSecEval 2 - A Comprehensive Evaluation Framework for Cybersecurity Risks and Capabilities of Large Language Models
item.description: CyberSecEval 2 is a comprehensive evaluation framework for assessing security risks and capabilities of LLMs. Important research for security-critical LLM deployments. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 7/10)

item.title: [tooling] SigmanticAI/apex-inference-chip — An inference chip design that runs a real LLM (Qwen2.5-0.5B) on FPGA — one transformer decoder layer in RTL, every silicon value bit-exact against a golden model. 0.56 tok/s measured, a 140× climb, full evidence trail.
item.description: FPGA inference chip design running Qwen2.5-0.5B with one RTL transformer decoder layer achieving 0.56 tok/s. Demonstrates bit-exact model replication on custom hardware. (via GitHub trending, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
item.description: StateM improves long-horizon agent execution to 95.3% on Terminal-Bench via harness scaling, achieving frontier performance at $15 compute cost. (via HF daily papers, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] ASI-Bench: At the Dawn of Artificial Superintelligence
item.description: ASI-Bench benchmarks frontier models on knowledge creation and exploration beyond training data. Evaluates reasoning and discovery capabilities. (via HF daily papers, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
item.description: FreeToken: MoE serving system optimizing edge inference with bandwidth-adaptive execution. Treats personal machines as unified elastic platforms for frontier models. (via HF daily papers, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows
item.description: StartupBench: Market-validated workflow benchmark for general-purpose agents. Evaluates real-world productivity gains from agentic systems. (via HF daily papers, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Abra: Scaling Diffusion Image Training
item.description: Abra: Systematic scaling law study for text-to-image diffusion models across three orders of magnitude. Guides compute-optimal training of visual generation. (via HF daily papers, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Releasing Outlines-core 0.1.0: structured generation in Rust and Python
item.description: Outlines-core 0.1.0 brings structured generation capabilities to Rust and Python. Enables constrained decoding for deterministic model outputs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Welcome, Gradio 5
item.description: Gradio 5 release with new features for model UI deployment. Updates the popular interface framework for LLM demos. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Faster Assisted Generation with Dynamic Speculation
item.description: Dynamic speculation technique for faster assisted generation in LLMs. Improves inference speed through speculative decoding. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Introducing the Open FinLLM Leaderboard
item.description: Open FinLLM Leaderboard introduced for benchmarking financial LLMs. Provides evaluation standard for domain-specific models. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [fine-tune] Fine-tuning LLMs to 1.58bit: extreme quantization made easy
item.description: Method for fine-tuning LLMs at extreme 1.58-bit quantization. Enables ultra-low-bitwidth model training and deployment. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Introduction to ggml
item.description: Introduction to ggml framework for efficient inference. Core library for running quantized models locally. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Tool Use, Unified
item.description: Unified tool-use framework for LLMs. Standardizes how models interact with external tools and APIs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Serverless Inference with Hugging Face and NVIDIA NIM
item.description: Serverless inference combining Hugging Face and NVIDIA NIM. Hosted inference solution for deploying LLMs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] TGI Multi-LoRA: Deploy Once, Serve 30 Models
item.description: TGI Multi-LoRA enables serving 30 models from single deployment. Efficient inference framework for multi-adapter serving. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] How NuminaMath Won the 1st AIMO Progress Prize
item.description: NuminaMath's winning approach for AIMO Progress Prize in mathematics reasoning. Documents techniques for mathematical problem-solving in LLMs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Google Cloud TPUs made available to Hugging Face users
item.description: Google Cloud TPUs available to Hugging Face users. Infrastructure support for training on TPU accelerators. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Our Transformers Code Agent beats the GAIA benchmark 🏅
item.description: Transformers Code Agent achieves state-of-the-art on GAIA benchmark. Agent-based reasoning outperforms baselines. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] BigCodeBench: The Next Generation of HumanEval
item.description: BigCodeBench is a new benchmark for code generation models that extends HumanEval with broader evaluation capabilities. Developers evaluating code LLMs will benefit from more comprehensive performance metrics. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Diffusers welcomes Stable Diffusion 3
item.description: Stable Diffusion 3 support added to Hugging Face Diffusers library. Enables open-source image generation development with a new model release. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Putting RL back in RLHF
item.description: Article on reinforcement learning techniques applied to RLHF training for LLMs. Covers practical improvements to alignment training methodology. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Launching the Artificial Analysis Text to Image Leaderboard & Arena
item.description: Artificial Analysis Text-to-Image Leaderboard launched on Hugging Face for benchmarking generative models. Provides comparative evaluation of open and closed image generation models. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Benchmarking Text Generation Inference
item.description: Benchmarking analysis of Hugging Face Text Generation Inference performance. Provides performance metrics for production inference evaluation. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Unlocking Longer Generation with Key-Value Cache Quantization
item.description: Technique for quantizing key-value cache to reduce memory during long-context generation. Improves inference efficiency for extended outputs. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] License to Call: Introducing Transformers Agents 2.0
item.description: Transformers Agents 2.0 introduces improved agentic capabilities and tool calling for LLMs. Advances tooling for building autonomous agent applications. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [research] Bringing the Artificial Analysis LLM Performance Leaderboard to Hugging Face
item.description: Artificial Analysis LLM Performance Leaderboard integrated into Hugging Face for centralized model benchmarking. Provides comprehensive performance comparisons for model selection. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [tooling] Powerful ASR + diarization + speculative decoding with Hugging Face Inference Endpoints
item.description: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints now supports ASR, diarization, and speculative decoding together. Enables optimized audio processing pipelines in production. (via Hugging Face Blog, importance 6/10)

item.title: [fine-tune] incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2
item.description: DFlash2 speculative decoding fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B with draft-model optimization for vLLM/SGLang inference acceleration. (via HF trending, importance 5/10)

item.title: [research] AI usage patterns in software teams
item.description: Research on AI usage patterns in software development teams. Data-driven analysis of practical LLM adoption in production workflows. (via Hacker News, importance 5/10)

item.title: [tooling] The Mojo language (by Modular, now Qualcomm) is now open-source
item.description: Mojo language by Modular (now Qualcomm) is open-sourced. Relevant for AI infrastructure as performance-focused language for ML systems. (via Hacker News, importance 5/10)
